name: Chemosit (African Monsters (PF1))
body:
CHEMOSIT
CR 6

This enormous bird-like creature has colorful feathered wings and a single muscular leg ending in a massive claw. From its open beak comes an unearthly sparkling light, streaming out of its throat.

XP 2,400
CE Large outsider (chaotic, demon, evil, native)
Init +6; Senses darkvision 120 ft., true seeing; Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 11, flat-footed 17 (+2 Dex, +8 natural, –1 size)
hp 76 (9d10+27)
Fort +6, Ref +8, Will +6
DR 10/cold iron or good; Immune electricity, poison; Resist acid 10, cold 10, fire 10

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., fly 60 ft. (average)
Melee bite +12 (1d8+4), claw +12 (2d6+4)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft. (5 ft. with claw)
Special Attacks breath weapon (15-ft. cone, 8d6 fire damage, Reflex DC 17 for half, usable every 1d4 rounds), brimstone breath (DC 17), fascinate
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th; concentration +10; save DCs are Intbased)

Constant—true seeing
At will—command (DC 14, approach option only) dancing lights, hypnotic pattern (DC 15), hypnotism (DC 14), minor image (DC 15)

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 14, Con 17, Int 17, Wis 10, Cha 11
Base Atk +9; CMB +14; CMD 26 (24 vs. trip)
Feats Combat Reflexes, Improved Initiative, Lunge, Power Attack, Ready for Anything
Skills Bluff +12, Diplomacy +12, Fly +12, Intimidate +12, Knowledge (planes) +15, Perception +12, Perform (sing) +12, Sense Motive +12, Stealth +10
Languages Abyssal, Celestial, Common; telepathy 60 ft.
SQ accompaniment, change shape (humanoid form, alter self), glowing gullet

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Accompaniment (Su)

When a chemosit uses one of its spell-like abilities it can also cast minor illusion as a swift action to add the sound of voices or music to a visual illusion.

Brimstone Breath (Su)

A chemosit unleashes a blast of darkness and stench from its mouth. When a chemosit uses its breath weapon, all creatures in the area are also nauseated by the stench for 1d4 rounds (DC 17 Fort save negates). Creatures that fail can attempt new saving throws to end the nauseated condition each round at the end of their turn. This is a poison effect. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Change Shape (Su)

When a chemosit uses change shape ability, its body transforms into a Medium-sized mostly humanoid form, with its wings becoming arms it can use to manipulate items, its neck shrinking and its head becoming rounded and mostly humanoid, although its jaws remain beak-like. In this form, it still appears somewhat birdlike and typically uses a long sharpened staff as a walking stick, because it cannot fly and must hop about on its single foot.

Fascinate (Su)

A chemosit can use the bardic performance fascinate ability as if it were a bard of level equal to its Hit Dice. The Will save to negates this effect is DC 14, or DC 16 for creatures that can also see the chemosit’s glowing gullet.

Glowing Gullet (Su)

An eerie glow radiates from the chemosit’s throat when its mouth is open, shedding bright light within 20 feet, and it can cause this light to sparkle and dance as it croons and sings a festive tune. It can close its mouth to douse this glow. This grants the chemosit a +2 racial bonus to its fascinate ability against those that can see the glow.

ECOLOGY

The chemosit is a tall, bird-like demon that hops about on a single leg and massive claw and a muscular leg surmounted by nine buttocks. It can shift its body between a more birdlike form with colorful feathered wings and that of a leering bald humanoid leaning with a hunched back on a walking stick. In either form, its eyes glow with an unearthly light and a similar glow arises from his gullet whenever its mouth is open. Chemosits are cruel and crave the flesh of people, in particular hungering for children. They use their magic to reinforce the eerie but enchanting lights and enticing songs to lure the unwary into the darkness to join what seems to be a party but which turns out to only be a feast for the demon.
